summary: node1 now serves a persistent RHEL 10 package repository from local storage over HTTP. The tree package was installed exclusively from that repository while remote access was deliberately unreachable. A reboot confirmed the repository, Apache service, metadata, RPM payload, and installed package persist.
actions_performed: Created /var/www/html/rhel10-local containing the signed tree RPM and repository metadata.
Configured the enabled rhel10-local DNF repository at http://10.100.197.10/rhel10-local.
Proved remote repository metadata retrieval failed through an unreachable proxy.
Installed tree using only rhel10-local under the same unreachable-proxy condition.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified HTTP service, repository data, configuration, checksum, and tree recovered after restart.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Shows RPM staging, metadata generation, enabled and active Apache service, port 80 listener, and successful retrieval of repomd.xml through node1's managed address.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: The remote-only metadata refresh failed; the local-only transaction succeeded and installed tree-2.1.0-8.el10 from rhel10-local; the installed binary executes successfully.

Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and post-restart recovery of Apache, port 80, repository metadata, RPM checksum, local DNF visibility, and installed tree package.
